name: sci-workplace
description: Sci Workplace local-first multi-agent research harness

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @openlab/protocol build && pnpm --filter @openlab/kernel build && pnpm --filter @openlab/plugin-sdk build && pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.test:citation-acceptance: pnpm --filter @openlab/runtime build && pnpm --filter @openlab/citation-plugin build && node scripts/citation-workbench-acceptance.mjs
scripts.test:citation-scan-acceptance: pnpm --filter @openlab/runtime build && pnpm --filter @openlab/citation-plugin build && node scripts/citation-workbench-acceptance.mjs --scan-only
scripts.test:citation-word-smoke: pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/word-zotero-smoke.ps1 -InputPath "acceptance/citation-workbench-v1/参考文献测试/参考文献测试.citation-revised.docx" -OutputPath "acceptance/citation-workbench-v1/word-smoke/参考文献测试.word-zotero-refresh.docx" -ReceiptPath "acceptance/citation-workbench-v1/word-smoke/word-zotero-smoke-receipt.json" -ExpectedBibliographyText "A statistical understanding of oxygen vacancies"
